NewsArticle.Title: Religion Expansion
NewsArticle.Content:
Thank you for your good feedback on Religion Expansion. We made the following improvements to what is already the most interactive and feature-rich religion system in any online RPG:
- Legend date for initiations is the first initiation instead of the most recent, so that priests may proudly display their long-standing faith.
- Prayer and Summon secret given at "Fellowship" if the priest had accidentally forgotten it.
- A priest may admit a guest ((even if unregistered)) into the temple by assuming responsibility for the guest's good behavior.
- An Aisling-recognized talent may advance into fellowship by oneself.
- We eliminated all reported bugs, including special conditions that may affect: leaving fellowship, shifting faith, staff or symbol consecration, and giving mass.
